data.description: From the Result Validator report (2026-10-04, Drift item 1, the most important finding; no plan row covers it). Every bank question (q3, q4, q7, q8) stores its correct option at index 4 (E); slot_for_day in pipeline/src/popquiz/slot.py is pure and passes every audit, but nothing on main @ 0a4b6fb calls it to arrange a question. room/src/question.rs:16-17 says the room never arranges (the arrangement is the pipeline's, AC-23, T-20); pipeline/src/popquiz/bank.py:28 makes arranging the caller's job; fallback.py:27-28 renders stored order. T-20 (PQ-25, schedule and sync) was never built, so a room or a static fallback built from this tree today shows the answer at E every night: the AC-23 failure the house rules guard hardest. Not a defect of any merged PR (each says arranging is T-20's job); a hazard of the interim state before HC-1. Two shapes, the client picks: (A) build T-20's push half now (PQ-25, which also carries sync for the in-memory used ledger), or (B) a stop-gap that applies slot_for_day(date) wherever a question is pushed (the admin PUT path or the organizer's upload tool) or baked (fallback.py), with the room and the fallback rendering the arranged order and bank-audit's option-position tell reading the arranged order. Constraints: AC-23/23a/23b, PHILOSOPHY section 2: a uniform draw from the date and nothing else; never balance, never avoid last meetup's letter; port slot_for_day only, never slot_for_meetup; mvp/ is read-only. Acceptance: a room created for a given date shows the options arranged by slot_for_day(date); the static fallback for that date matches; the canary and every existing suite stay green; bank-audit's option-position tell runs over the arranged order; a test proves two different dates give two different arrangements of the same question. HELD on the client's choice between A and B (scope decision; Moderate autonomy surfaces it).
